answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 64 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in echo, queued in prism, and ivory publishes the wait time. A farm of 98 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4046 identities would post 4501 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
